### Bio
I am Muhammad Badr ABU SALIH, a researcher in political science, and a former lecturer at the [University of Aleppo](https://alepuniv.edu.sy/){.external target="_blank"}, Faculty of Arts and Humanities.

I specialize in comparative politics, mainly on democracy and democratization, with a focus on the Middle East.

I got my MA in Political Science and International Relations from [Altınbaş University](https://altinbas.edu.tr/){.external target="_blank"} in Istanbul, with a thesis titled “Misdirected by The Successes of The Others: The Case of Syria in The Arab Spring”.

I am committed to engaging in more puzzles, conducting rigorous research, and sharing ideas in the field, with the aim of contributing to our collective knowledge to strengthen democracy around the world.


### Interests

- Comparative Politics
- Democracy and Democratization
- Authoritarianism
- Computational Social Science
